subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should persistent multi-agent workspace context live in the Dashboard breadcrumb/header surface after the current chrome refactor, or should it move to the sidebar/chat shell direction represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101017?
rationale: The focused fix is useful, but current main moved the touched files and an open maintainer-labeled PR disputes the breadcrumb/topbar surface; automation cannot safely choose the long-term UI contract.

options.title: Keep Header Context
options.body: Rebase this behavior onto `ui/src/app/app-host.ts`, `ui/src/components/app-topbar.ts`, and `ui/src/components/dashboard-header.ts` so multi-agent chat keeps an agent plus workspace breadcrumb.

options.title: Move Context Into New Shell
options.body: Require the header redesign path to preserve an equivalent persistent agent/workspace indicator in its replacement surface before closing the linked issue.

options.title: Defer To Projects UX
options.body: Pause this PR and keep the broader project/workspace design open until maintainers define a first-class Projects or session-target surface.

recommendation.title: Move Context Into New Shell
recommendation.body: Require the header redesign path to preserve an equivalent persistent agent/workspace indicator in its replacement surface before closing the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the current Dashboard chrome redesign that this PR must now integrate with or intentionally avoid.
